notices: K-ETA application is available only at "www.k-eta.go.kr" or the mobile app (K-ETA).(Application fee: approximately USD 7~8)

Items (Required) Email address, ID photo, copy of passport bio page, passport information (nationality, name, sex, date of birth, passport number, passport expiration date, personal identification number), purpose of entry, intended place of stay, contact information of intended place of stay, expected date of arrival, expected date of departure, occupation, contact information, whether you have visited Kore, whether or not you have multiple nationalities, country of birth, place of birth, address of current residence, whether or not you have changed your name, whether you have acquaintances in Korea, whether you have accompanying persons, whether you are engaged in economic activities, monthly income, experience of visiting other countries
(Optional) Planned departure flight number, SNS account
Items Information on infectious disease, overseas criminal record, and criminal record in Korea
Basis of collection, use, and processing: Article 7-3, Article 11, Article 12 of the Immigration Act, Article 101 of the Enforcement Decree of the Immigration Act
When applying for K-ETA as a non-member, children under the age of 14 cannot be designated as the "Representative".
